maintenance.description: GPU VBIOS + BMC firmware upgrade, node drained
Ports cabled for future server-13-03; intentionally unconnected

interventions.reason: Grid demand-response event (National Grid DFS window)

bmc.post_code.note: Power-on self-test code. 'stuck' = server never finished booting.

chiller.outdoor_temp_c.note: Outdoor weather: an explanatory driver, never a fault by itself.

control.power_cap_change.note: Audit event for a power-cap change. Carries labels.interventionId when we did it.

exporter.dcgm_up.note: Collector health. False = GPU readings for this server's children are not fresh, whatever their values say (F06).

gpu.ecc_dbe_total.note: Double-bit (uncorrectable) errors corrupt data. Any increase is critical.

gpu.ecc_sbe_total.note: Single-bit (corrected) memory errors. A few per day is normal (B06); a burst is a precursor (F02).

gpu.pcie_link_gen.note: Lower than expected = link has down-trained (runs slower).

gpu.pcie_replay_total.note: PCIe replay = packet re-sent because it failed its checksum on the CPU<->GPU link.

gpu.power_limit_w.note: Configured power cap. A change here should match an Intervention record.

gpu.power_w.note: Short excursions near the limit during big matrix ops are normal (B03). The live limit may be lowered by an intervention: see gpu.power_limit_w.

gpu.remapped_rows_pending.note: True = memory row remap needs a GPU reset to take effect.

gpu.throttle_reasons.note: software = intentional/explainable; hardware = a fault until proven otherwise.

gpu.utilization_percent.note: 100% utilisation does NOT prove progress: NCCL spin-wait shows 100% while stalled (F07).

13.meaning: Graphics engine exception (often an application bug)

63.meaning: ECC page retirement / row remap recorded

64.meaning: ECC page retirement / row remap failed

79.meaning: GPU has fallen off the bus (no longer reachable)

inference.p99_latency_ms.note: p99 = 99th percentile: 1 in 100 requests is slower than this.

inference.requests_per_second.note: User demand: an explanatory driver (B08), not a fault by itself.

port.crc_errors_total.note: CRC error = packet corrupted in transit and re-sent. Large static totals are history, not a fault.

port.effective_ber.note: Bit error rate: fraction of bits received wrong. Healthy NDR links are ~1e-15.

port.link_downed_total.note: Link flap counter: how many times the link went down and came back.

port.link_up.note: Only a fault if the port's adminState is 'up' (B09).

room.inlet_temp_c.note: ASHRAE = industry body whose guidelines set recommended hall air temperatures (18-27C).

workload.last_log_line_age_s.note: Seconds since the job last wrote a log line.

workload.phase.note: See Workload.phase enum. Phase explains a dip only within its time budget.

workload.queue_wait_s.note: How long a queued job has waited for its GPUs.

workload.status.note: Scheduler status: queued | running | completed | failed | cancelled.

workload.steps_completed.note: Progress heartbeat. Flat while status=running and phase=train = stalled (F07).

workloadPhaseEnum.pending: Queued, no GPUs running it yet.
workloadPhaseEnum.starting: Loading model/data; GPUs warming up. Load ramps are expected.
workloadPhaseEnum.train: Normal training steps. Full load expected.
workloadPhaseEnum.eval: Evaluation pass. Load may be lower.
workloadPhaseEnum.checkpoint: Writing a checkpoint to storage. GPUs mostly idle, storage write burst expected.
workloadPhaseEnum.serving: Inference serving. Load follows user demand.
